summary.text: Martin Hickey is a Democrat who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2021, representing District 20 in Bernalillo County.
Hickey is vice chair of the Senate Health and Public Affairs Committee and also sits on the Senate Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Hickey's legislative page lists a district office in Albuquerque.
Between sessions, Hickey chairs the Tobacco Settlement Revenue Oversight Committee.
